{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Auth.Server (runAuthServer) where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Bits (xor)
import Data.IORef
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isSuffixOf, foldl')
import Data.Pool
import Network.Wai
import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp
import Network.HTTP.Types
import System.Directory
import System.FilePath
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 as BL
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE

data AuthConfig = AuthConfig
  { configBaseDir    :: FilePath
  , configSessionDir :: FilePath
  , configStaticDir  :: FilePath
  , configPool       :: Pool Connection
  , configAdminToken :: BS.ByteString
  , configUserToken  :: BS.ByteString
  }

data Connection = Connection { connId :: Int }

data SessionState = SessionState
  { sessionUser  :: Maybe String
  , sessionPerms :: [String]
  }

mkPool :: IO (Pool Connection)
mkPool = createPool (pure (Connection 1)) (\_ -> pure ()) 1 30 10

initConfig :: IO AuthConfig
initConfig = do
  pool <- mkPool
  -- Secrets should be loaded from a secure source (env/secret store) in
  -- production; placeholders shown here must be replaced at deployment.
  adminTok <- BS.pack <$> getSecret "AUTH_ADMIN_TOKEN"
  userTok  <- BS.pack <$> getSecret "AUTH_USER_TOKEN"
  pure AuthConfig
    { configBaseDir    = "/var/lib/authservice"
    , configSessionDir = "/var/lib/authservice/sessions"
    , configStaticDir  = "/var/lib/authservice/static"
    , configPool       = pool
    , configAdminToken = adminTok
    , configUserToken  = userTok
    }

-- | Placeholder secret loader. Replace with reads from environment or a
-- secret manager. Returns empty string if unset (which will never match a
-- presented token, effectively denying access).
getSecret :: String -> IO String
getSecret _ = pure ""

-- | Constant-time equality for byte strings to avoid timing side channels.
constantTimeEq :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeEq a b =
  BS.length a == BS.length b &&
  foldl' (\acc (x, y) -> acc + fromEnum (x `xor` y)) 0
    (BS.zip a b) == 0

-- | Normalize a path component, removing traversal attempts
normalizePath :: FilePath -> FilePath
normalizePath p = 
  let cleaned = filter (not . null) $ splitDirectories p
      -- Remove any ".." components
      safe = filter (/= "..") cleaned
  in joinPath safe

-- | Check if a resolved path is within the allowed base
isWithinBase :: FilePath -> FilePath -> IO Bool
isWithinBase base target = do
  canonBase <- canonicalizePath base
  canonTarget <- canonicalizePath target
  pure $ canonBase `isPrefixOf` canonTarget

-- | Authenticate user from request headers
authenticateRequest :: AuthConfig -> Request -> IO (Maybe SessionState)
authenticateRequest config req = do
  let authHeader = lookup "Authorization" (requestHeaders req)
  case authHeader of
    Just token -> validateToken config token
    Nothing    -> pure Nothing

-- | Validate the presented bearer token against configured secrets using a
-- constant-time comparison of the full token value. No prefix-based trust.
validateToken :: AuthConfig -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Maybe SessionState)
validateToken config presented
  | BS.null (configAdminToken config) && BS.null (configUserToken config) =
      pure Nothing
  | not (BS.null (configAdminToken config))
      && constantTimeEq presented ("Bearer " `BS.append` configAdminToken config) =
      pure $ Just SessionState
        { sessionUser = Just "admin"
        , sessionPerms = ["read", "write", "list"]
        }
  | not (BS.null (configUserToken config))
      && constantTimeEq presented ("Bearer " `BS.append` configUserToken config) =
      pure $ Just SessionState
        { sessionUser = Just "user"
        , sessionPerms = ["read"]
        }
  | otherwise = pure Nothing

-- | Serve static files with directory listing for authorized users
serveStatic :: AuthConfig -> SessionState -> FilePath -> IO Response
serveStatic config session requestedPath = do
  let normalized = normalizePath requestedPath
      fullPath = configStaticDir config </> normalized
  
  -- Security check: ensure path is within static directory
  exists <- doesPathExist fullPath
  if not exists
    then pure $ responseLBS status404 [] "Not found"
    else do
      withinBase <- isWithinBase (configStaticDir config) fullPath
      if not withinBase
        then pure $ responseLBS status403 [] "Access denied"
        else do
          isDir <- doesDirectoryExist fullPath
          if isDir
            then handleDirectoryRequest config session fullPath
            else serveFile fullPath

handleDirectoryRequest :: AuthConfig -> SessionState -> FilePath -> IO Response
handleDirectoryRequest config session dirPath = do
  -- Check if user has list permission
  if "list" `elem` sessionPerms session
    then do
      contents <- listDirectory dirPath
      let listing = unlines $ map formatEntry contents
      pure $ responseLBS status200
        [("Content-Type", "text/plain")]
        (BL.pack listing)
    else
      -- Fall back to looking for index.html
      let indexPath = dirPath </> "index.html"
      in do
        hasIndex <- doesFileExist indexPath
        if hasIndex
          then serveFile indexPath
          else pure $ responseLBS status403 [] "Directory listing not permitted"

formatEntry :: FilePath -> String
formatEntry f = "  " ++ f

serveFile :: FilePath -> IO Response
serveFile fp = do
  content <- BL.readFile fp
  let ct = guessContentType fp
  pure $ responseLBS status200 [("Content-Type", ct)] content

guessContentType :: FilePath -> BS.ByteString
guessContentType fp
  | ".html" `isSuffixOf` fp = "text/html"
  | ".css"  `isSuffixOf` fp = "text/css"
  | ".js"   `isSuffixOf` fp = "application/javascript"
  | otherwise               = "application/octet-stream"

-- | Main application handler
app :: AuthConfig -> Application
app config req respond = do
  let path = T.unpack $ T.intercalate "/" $ pathInfo req
      method = requestMethod req
  
  session <- authenticateRequest config req
  
  case (method, session) of
    ("GET", Just sess) -> do
      resp <- serveStatic config sess path
      respond resp
    ("GET", Nothing) ->
      respond $ responseLBS status401 [] "Authentication required"
    _ ->
      respond $ responseLBS status405 [] "Method not allowed"

runAuthServer :: IO ()
runAuthServer = do
  config <- initConfig
  run 8080 (app config)
